Name: Bulbasaur
Description: A strange seed was planted on its back at birth. The plant sprouts and grows with this Pokemon.

Name: Ivysaur
Description: When the bulb on its back grows large, it appears to lose the ability to stand on its hind legs.

Name: Venusaur
Description: The plant blooms when it is absorbing solar energy. It stays on the move to seek sunlight.

Name: Mega Venusaur
Description: Obviously prefers hot places. When it rains, steam is said to spout from the tip of its tail.

Name: Charmander
Description: When it swings its burning tail, it elevates the temperature to unbearably high levels.

Name: Charmeleon
Description: Spits fire that is hot enough to melt boulders. Known to cause forest fires unintentionally.

Name: Charizard
Description: After birth, its back swells and hardens into a shell. Powerfully sprays foam from its mouth.

Name: Mega Charizard
Description: Often hides in water to stalk unwary prey. For swimming fast, it moves its ears to maintain balance.

Name: Mega Charizard X
Description: A brutal Pokemon with pressurized water jets on its shell. They are used for high speed tackles.

Name: Squirtle
Description: Its short feet are tipped with suction pads that enable it to tirelessly climb slopes and walls.

Name: Wartortle
Description: This Pokemon is vulnerable to attack while its shell is soft, exposing its weak and tender body.

Name: Blastoise
Description: In battle, it flaps its wings at high speed to release highly toxic dust into the air.

Name: Mega Blastoise
Description: Often found in forests, eating leaves. It has a sharp venomous stinger on its head.

Name: Caterpie
Description: Almost incapable of moving, this Pokemon can only harden its shell to protect itself from predators.

Name: Metapod
Description: It has three poisonous stingers on its forelegs and its tail. They are used to jab its enemy repeatedly.

Name: Butterfree
Description: A common sight in forests and woods. It flaps its wings at ground level to kick up blinding sand.

Name: Weedle
Description: Very protective of its sprawling territorial area, this Pokemon will fiercely peck at any intruder.

Name: Kakuna
Description: When hunting, it skims the surface of water at high speed to pick off unwary prey such as MAGIKARP.

Name: Beedrill
Description: Bites anything when it attacks. Small and very quick, it is a common sight in many places.

Name: Mega Beedrill
Description: It uses its whiskers to maintain its balance. It apparently slows down if they are cut off.

Name: Pidgey
Description: It flaps its small wings busily to fly. Using its beak, it searches in grass for prey.

Name: Pidgeotto
Description: With its huge and magnificent wings, it can keep aloft without ever having to land for rest.

Name: Pidgeot
Description: Moves silently and stealthily. Eats the eggs of birds, such as PIDGEY and SPEAROW, whole.

Name: Mega Pidgeot
Description: It is rumored that the ferocious warning markings on its belly differ from area to area.

Name: Rattata
Description: When several of these Pokemon gather, their electricity could build and cause lightning storms.

Name: Mega Rattata
Description: Its long tail serves as a ground to protect itself from its own high-voltage power.

Name: Raticate
Description: Burrows deep underground in arid locations far from water. It only emerges to hunt for food.

Name: Mega Raticate
Description: Curls up into a spiny ball when threatened. It can roll while curled up to attack or escape.

Name: Spearow
Description: Although small, its venomous barbs render this Pokemon dangerous. The female has smaller horns.

Name: Fearow
Description: The female's horn develops slowly. Prefers physical attacks such as clawing and biting.

Name: Ekans
Description: Its hard scales provide strong protection. It uses its hefty bulk to execute powerful moves.

Name: Arbok
Description: Stiffens its ears to sense danger. The larger its horns, the more powerful its secreted venom.

Name: Pikachu
Description: An aggressive Pokemon that is quick to attack. The horn on its head secretes a powerful venom.

Name: Mega Pikachu
Description: It uses its powerful tail in battle to smash, constrict, then break the prey's bones.

Name: Raichu
Description: Its magical and cute appeal has many admirers. It is rare and found only in certain areas.

Name: Mega Raichu
Description: A timid fairy Pokemon that is rarely seen. It will run and hide the moment it senses people.

Name: Sandshrew
Description: At the time of birth, it has just one tail. The tail splits from its tip as it grows older.

Name: Mega Sandshrew
Description: Very smart and very vengeful. Grabbing one of its many tails could result in a 1000-year curse.

Name: Sandslash
Description: When its huge eyes light up, it sings a mysteriously soothing melody that lulls its enemies to sleep.

Name: Mega Sandslash
Description: The body is soft and rubbery. When angered, it will suck in air and inflate itself to an enormous size.

Name: Nidoran♀
Description: Forms colonies in perpetually dark places. Uses ultrasonic waves to identify and approach targets.

Name: Nidorina
Description: Once it strikes, it will not stop draining energy from the victim even if it gets too heavy to fly.

Name: Nidoqueen
Description: During the day, it keeps its face buried in the ground. At night, it wanders around sowing its seeds.

Name: Nidoran♂
Description: The fluid that oozes from its mouth isn't drool. It is a nectar that is used to attract prey.

Name: Nidorino
Description: It has the world's largest petals. With every step, the petals shake out heavy clouds of toxic pollen.

Name: Nidoking
Description: Burrows to suck tree roots. The mushrooms on its back grow by drawing nutrients from the bug host.

Name: Clefairy
Description: A host-parasite pair in which the parasite mushroom has taken over the host bug. Prefers damp places.

Name: Clefable
Description: Lives in the shadows of tall trees where it eats insects. It is attracted by light at night.

Name: Vulpix
Description: The dustlike scales covering its wings are color-coded to indicate the kinds of poison it has.

Name: Mega Vulpix
Description: Lives about one yard underground where it feeds on plant roots. It sometimes appears above ground.

Name: Ninetales
Description: A team of DIGLETT triplets. It triggers huge earthquakes by burrowing 60 miles underground.

Name: Mega Ninetales
Description: It washes its face regularly to keep the coin on its forehead spotless. It doesn't get along with Galarian Meowth.

Name: Jigglypuff
Description: Although its fur has many admirers, it is tough to raise as a pet because of its fickle meanness.

Name: Wigglytuff
Description: While lulling its enemies with its vacant look, this wily Pokemon will use psychokinetic powers.

Name: Zubat
Description: Often seen swimming elegantly by lake shores. It is often mistaken for the Japanese monster, Kappa.

Name: Golbat
Description: Extremely quick to anger. It could be docile one moment then thrashing away the next instant.

Name: Oddish
Description: Always furious and tenacious to boot. It will not abandon chasing its quarry until it is caught.

Name: Gloom
Description: Very protective of its territory. It will bark and bite to repel intruders from its space.

Name: Vileplume
Description: A Pokemon that has been admired since the past for its beauty. It runs agilely as if on wings.

Name: Paras
Description: Its newly grown legs prevent it from running. It appears to prefer swimming than trying to stand.

Name: Parasect
Description: Capable of living in or out of water. When out of water, it sweats to keep its body slimy.

Name: Venonat
Description: An adept swimmer at both the front crawl and breast stroke. Easily overtakes the best human swimmers.

Name: Venomoth
Description: Using its ability to read minds, it will identify impending danger and TELEPORT to safety.

Name: Diglett
Description: It emits special alpha waves from its body that induce headaches just by being close by.

Name: Mega Diglett
Description: Its brain can outperform a supercomputer. Its intelligence quotient is said to be 5,000.

Name: Dugtrio
Description: Loves to build its muscles. It trains in all styles of martial arts to become even stronger.

Name: Mega Dugtrio
Description: Its muscular body is so powerful, it must wear a power save belt to be able to regulate its motions.

Name: Meowth
Description: Using its heavy muscles, it throws powerful punches that can send the victim clear over the horizon.

Name: Mega Meowth
Description: A carnivorous Pokemon that traps and eats bugs. It uses its root feet to soak up needed moisture.

Name: Mega Meowth X
Description: It spits out POISONPOWDER to immobilize the enemy and then finishes it with a spray of ACID.

Name: Persian
Description: Said to live in huge colonies deep in jungles, although no one has ever returned from there.

Name: Mega Persian
Description: Drifts in shallow seas. Anglers who hook them by accident are often punished by its stinging acid.

Name: Psyduck
Description: The tentacles are normally kept short. On hunts, they are extended to ensnare and immobilize prey.

Name: Golduck
Description: Found in fields and mountains. Mistaking them for boulders, people often step or trip on them.

Name: Mankey
Description: Rolls down slopes to move. It rolls over any obstacle without slowing or changing its direction.

Name: Primeape
Description: Its boulder-like body is extremely hard. It can easily withstand dynamite blasts without damage.

Name: Growlithe
Description: Its hooves are 10 times harder than diamonds. It can trample anything completely flat in little time.

Name: Arcanine
Description: Very competitive, this Pokemon will chase anything that moves fast in the hopes of racing it.

Name: Poliwag
Description: Incredibly slow and dopey. It takes 5 seconds for it to feel pain when under attack.

Name: Poliwhirl
Description: The SHELLDER that is latched onto SLOWPOKE's tail is said to feed on the host's left over scraps.

Name: Poliwrath
Description: Uses anti-gravity to stay suspended. Appears without warning and uses THUNDER WAVE and similar moves.

Name: Abra
Description: Formed by several MAGNEMITEs linked together. They frequently appear when sunspots flare up.

Name: Kadabra
Description: The sprig of green onions it holds is its weapon. It is used much like a metal sword.

Name: Alakazam
Description: A bird that makes up for its poor flying with its fast foot speed. Leaves giant footprints.

Name: Mega Alakazam
Description: Uses its three brains to execute complex plans. While two heads sleep, one head stays awake.

Name: Machop
Description: The protruding horn on its head is very hard. It is used for bashing through thick ice.

Name: Machoke
Description: Stores thermal energy in its body. Swims at a steady 8 knots even in intensely cold waters.

Name: Machamp
Description: Appears in filthy areas. Thrives by sucking up polluted sludge that is pumped out of factories.

Name: Bellsprout
Description: Thickly covered with a filthy, vile sludge. It is so toxic, even its footprints contain poison.

Name: Weepinbell
Description: Its hard shell repels any kind of attack. It is vulnerable only when its shell is open.

Name: Victreebel
Description: When attacked, it launches its horns in quick volleys. Its innards have never been seen.

Name: Tentacool
Description: Almost invisible, this gaseous Pokemon cloaks the target and puts it to sleep without notice.

Name: Tentacruel
Description: Because of its ability to slip through block walls, it is said to be from another dimension.

Name: Geodude
Description: Under a full moon, this Pokemon likes to mimic the shadows of people and laugh at their fright.

Name: Mega Geodude
Description: As it grows, the stone portions of its body harden to become similar to a diamond, but colored black.

Name: Graveler
Description: Puts enemies to sleep then eats their dreams. Occasionally gets sick from eating bad dreams.

Name: Mega Graveler
Description: When it locks eyes with an enemy, it will use a mix of PSI moves such as HYPNOSIS and CONFUSION.

Name: Golem
Description: Its pincers are not only powerful weapons, they are used for balance when walking sideways.

Name: Mega Golem
Description: The large pincer has 10000 hp of crushing power. However, its huge size makes it unwieldy to use.

Name: Ponyta
Description: Usually found in power plants. Easily mistaken for a POKé BALL, they have zapped many people.

Name: Mega Ponyta
Description: It stores electric energy under very high pressure. It often explodes with little or no provocation.

Name: Rapidash
Description: Often mistaken for eggs. When disturbed, they quickly gather and attack in swarms.

Name: Mega Rapidash
Description: Legend has it that on rare occasions, one of its heads will drop off and continue on as an EXEGGCUTE.

Name: Slowpoke
Description: Because it never removes its skull helmet, no one has ever seen this Pokemon's real face.

Name: Mega Slowpoke
Description: The bone it holds is its key weapon. It throws the bone skillfully like a boomerang to KO targets.

Name: Slowbro
Description: When in a hurry, its legs lengthen progressively. It runs smoothly with extra long, loping strides.

Name: Mega Slowbro
Description: While apparently doing nothing, it fires punches in lightning fast volleys that are impossible to see.

Name: Mega Slowbro X
Description: Its tongue can be extended like a chameleon's. It leaves a tingling sensation when it licks enemies.

Name: Magnemite
Description: Because it stores several kinds of toxic gases in its body, it is prone to exploding without warning.

Name: Magneton
Description: Where two kinds of poison gases meet, 2 KOFFINGs can fuse into a WEEZING over many years.

Name: Farfetch'd
Description: A Pokemon with a one-track mind. Once it charges,  it won't stop running until it falls asleep.

Name: Mega Farfetch'd
Description: Protected by an armor-like hide, it is capable of living in molten lava of 3,600 degrees.

Name: Doduo
Description: A rare and elusive Pokemon that is said to bring happiness to those who manage to get it.

Name: Dodrio
Description: The whole body is swathed with wide vines that are similar to seaweed. Its vines shake as it walks.

Name: Seel
Description: The infant rarely ventures out of its mother's protective pouch until it is 3 years old.

Name: Dewgong
Description: Known to shoot down flying bugs with precision blasts of ink from the surface of the water.

Name: Grimer
Description: Capable of swimming backwards by rapidly flapping its wing-like pectoral fins and stout tail.

Name: Mega Grimer
Description: Its tail fin billows like an elegant ballroom dress, giving it the nickname of the Water Queen.

Name: Muk
Description: In the autumn spawning season, they can be seen swimming powerfully up rivers and creeks.

Name: Mega Muk
Description: If its body is torn, it can grow back if the red core remains. The core flashes at midnight.

Name: Shellder
Description: Its central core glows with the seven colors of the rainbow. Some people value the core as a gem.

Name: Cloyster
Description: If interrupted while it is miming, it will slap around the offender with its broad hands.

Name: Gastly
Description: With ninja-like agility and speed, it can create the illusion that there is more than one.

Name: Haunter
Description: It seductively wiggles its hips as it walks. It can cause people to dance in unison with it.

Name: Gengar
Description: Normally found near power plants, they can wander away and cause major blackouts in cities.

Name: Mega Gengar
Description: Its body always burns with an orange glow that enables it to hide perfectly among flames.

Name: Onix
Description: If it fails to crush the victim in its pincers, it will swing it around and toss it hard.

Name: Drowzee
Description: When it targets an enemy, it charges furiously while whipping its body with its long tails.

Name: Hypno
Description: In the distant past, it was somewhat stronger than the horribly weak descendants that exist today.

Name: Krabby
Description: Once it begins to rampage, a GYARADOS will burn everything down, even in a harsh storm.

Name: Kingler
Description: A Pokemon that has been overhunted almost to extinction. It can ferry people across the water.

Name: Voltorb
Description: Capable of copying an enemy's genetic code to instantly transform itself into a duplicate of the enemy.

Name: Electrode
Description: Its genetic code is irregular. It may mutate if it is exposed to radiation from element STONEs.

Name: Exeggcute
Description: Lives close to water. Its long tail is ridged with a fin which is often mistaken for a mermaid's.

Name: Exeggutor
Description: It accumulates negative ions in the atmosphere to blast out 10000- volt lightning bolts.

Name: Mega Exeggutor
Description: When storing thermal energy in its body, its temperature could soar to over 1600 degrees.

Name: Cubone
Description: A Pokemon that consists entirely of programming code. Capable of moving freely in cyberspace.

Name: Marowak
Description: Although long extinct, in rare cases, it can be genetically resurrected from fossils.

Name: Mega Marowak
Description: A prehistoric Pokemon that died out when its heavy shell made it impossible to catch prey.

Name: Hitmonlee
Description: A Pokemon that was resurrected from a fossil found in what was once the ocean floor eons ago.

Name: Hitmonchan
Description: Its sleek shape is perfect for swimming. It slashes prey with its claws and drains the body fluids.

Name: Lickitung
Description: A Pokemon that roamed the skies in the dinosaur era. Its teeth are like saw blades.

Name: Koffing
Description: Very lazy. Just eats and sleeps. As its rotund bulk builds, it becomes steadily more slothful.

Name: Weezing
Description: A legendary bird Pokemon that is said to appear to doomed people who are lost in icy mountains.

Name: Mega Weezing
Description: A legendary bird Pokemon that is said to appear from clouds while dropping enormous lightning bolts.

Name: Rhyhorn
Description: Known as the legendary bird of fire. Every flap of its wings creates a dazzling flash of flames.

Name: Rhydon
Description: Long considered a mythical Pokemon until recently when a small colony was found living underwater.

Name: Chansey
Description: A mystical Pokemon that exudes a gentle aura. Has the ability to change climate conditions.

Name: Tangela
Description: An extremely rarely seen marine Pokemon. Its intelligence is said to match that of humans.

Name: Kangaskhan
Description: It was created by a scientist after years of horrific gene splicing and DNA engineering experiments.

Name: Mega Kangaskhan
Description: So rare that it is still said to be a mirage by many experts. Only a few people have seen it worldwide.

Name: Horsea
Description: A sweet aroma gently wafts from the leaf on its head. It is docile and loves to soak up the sun's rays.

Name: Seadra
Description: The scent of spices comes from around its neck. Somehow, sniffing it makes you want to fight.

Name: Goldeen
Description: The aroma that rises from its petals contains a substance that calms aggressive feelings.

Name: Seaking
Description: It has a timid nature. If it is startled, the flames on its back burn more vigorously.

Name: Staryu
Description: Be careful if it turns its back during battle. It means that it will attack with the fire on its back.

Name: Starmie
Description: If its rage peaks, it becomes so hot that anything that touches it will instantly go up in flames.

Name: Mr. Mime
Description: Its well-developed jaws are powerful and capable of crushing anything. Even its trainer must be careful.

Name: Mega Mr. Mime
Description: If it loses a fang, a new one grows back in its place. There are always 48 fangs lining its mouth.

Name: Scyther
Description: When it bites with its massive and powerful jaws, it shakes its head and savagely tears its victim up.

Name: Jynx
Description: A very cautious Pokemon, it raises itself up using its tail to get a better view of its surroundings.

Name: Electabuzz
Description: It makes a nest to suit its long and skinny body. The nest is impossible for other Pokemon to enter.

Name: Magmar
Description: It always stands on one foot. It changes feet so fast, the movement can rarely be seen.

Name: Pinsir
Description: Its eyes are specially adapted. They concentrate even faint light and enable it to see in the dark.

Name: Mega Pinsir
Description: It is very timid. It will be afraid to move if it is alone. But it will be active if it is in a group.

Name: Tauros
Description: When the stars flicker in the night sky, it flutters about, scattering a glowing powder.

Name: Magikarp
Description: It lies still in the same pose for days in its web, waiting for its unsuspecting prey to wander close.

Name: Gyarados
Description: It spins string not only from its rear but also from its mouth. It is hard to tell which end is which.

Name: Mega Gyarados
Description: It flies so silently through the dark on its four wings that it may not be noticed even when nearby.

Name: Lapras
Description: Chinchou blink their shining antennae at one another to claim their respective turf.

Name: Ditto
Description: The light it emits is so bright that it can illuminate the sea's surface from a depth of over three miles.

Name: Eevee
Description: It is not yet skilled at storing electricity. It may send out a jolt if amused or startled.

Name: Mega Eevee
Description: Because of its unusual, star-like silhouette, people believe that it came here on a meteor.

Name: Vaporeon
Description: It has a very soft body. If it starts to roll, it will bounce all over and be impossible to stop.

Name: Jolteon
Description: The shell seems to be filled with joy. It is said that it will share good luck when treated kindly.

Name: Flareon
Description: They say that it will appear before kindhearted, caring people and shower them with happiness.

Name: Porygon
Description: Because its wings aren't yet fully grown, it has to hop to get around. It is always staring at something.

Name: Omanyte
Description: They say that it stays still and quiet because it is seeing both the past and future at the same time.

Name: Omastar
Description: If static electricity builds in its body, its fleece doubles in volume. Touching it will shock you.

Name: Kabuto
Description: As a result of storing too much electricity, it developed patches where even downy wool won't grow.

Name: Kabutops
Description: The tail's tip shines brightly and can be seen from far away. It acts as a beacon for lost people.

Name: Aerodactyl
Description: Plentiful in the tropics. When it dances, its petals rub together and make a pleasant ringing sound.

Name: Mega Aerodactyl
Description: The tip of its tail, which contains oil that is lighter than water, lets it swim without drowning.

Name: Snorlax
Description: It lives in water virtually all day long. Its body color and pattern act as camouflage that makes it tough for enemies to spot in water.

Name: Articuno
Description: Although it always pretends to be a tree, its composition appears to be closer to a rock than a plant.

Name: Mega Articuno
Description: If POLIWAG and POLIWHIRL hear its echoing cry, they respond by gathering from far and wide.

Name: Zapdos
Description: To keep from being blown away by the wind, they gather in clusters. They do enjoy gentle breezes, though.

Name: Mega Zapdos
Description: The bloom on top of its head opens and closes as the temperature fluctuates up and down.

Name: Moltres
Description: Once it catches the wind, it deftly controls its cotton-puff spores to float, even around the world.

Name: Mega Moltres
Description: Its tail is so powerful that it can use it to grab a tree branch and hold itself up in the air.

Name: Dratini
Description: It may drop out of the sky suddenly. If attacked by a SPEAROW, it will violently shake its leaves.

Name: Dragonair
Description: It converts sunlight into energy. In the darkness after sunset, it closes its petals and becomes still.

Name: Dragonite
Description: If it flaps its wings really fast, it can generate shock waves that will shatter windows in the area.

Name: Mewtwo
Description: This Pokemon lives in cold water. It will leave the water to search for food when it gets cold outside.

Name: Mega Mewtwo
Description: This carefree Pokemon has an easy-going nature. While swimming, it always bumps into boat hulls.

Name: Mega Mewtwo X
Description: It uses the fine hair that covers its body to sense air currents and predict its enemy's actions.

Name: Mew
Description: When agitated, this Pokemon protects itself by spraying poisonous sweat from its pores.

Name: Chikorita
Description: Feared and loathed by many, it is believed to bring misfortune to all those who see it at night.

Name: Bayleef
Description: It has incredible intellect and intuition. Whatever the situation, it remains calm and collected.

Name: Meganium
Description: It likes playing mischievous tricks such as screaming and wailing to startle people at night.

Name: Cyndaquil
Description: Their shapes look like hieroglyphs on ancient tablets. It is said that the two are somehow related.

Name: Quilava
Description: It hates light and shock. If attacked, it inflates its body to pump up its counterstrike.

Name: Typhlosion
Description: Its tail has a small brain of its own. Beware! If you get close, it may react to your scent and bite.

Name: Totodile
Description: It likes to make its shell thicker by adding layers of tree bark. The additional weight doesn't bother it.

Name: Croconaw
Description: Its entire body is shielded by a steel-hard shell. What lurks inside the armor is a total mystery.

Name: Feraligatr
Description: When spotted, this Pokemon escapes backward by furiously boring into the ground with its tail.

Name: Sentret
Description: It flies straight at its target's face then clamps down on the startled victim to inject poison.

Name: Furret
Description: It is thought its body transformed as a result of iron accumulating internally from swallowing soil.

Name: Hoothoot
Description: Although it looks frightening, it is actually kind and affectionate. It is very popular among women.

Name: Noctowl
Description: It is actually timid and easily spooked. If attacked, it flails about to fend off its attacker.

Name: Ledyba
Description: To fire its poison spikes, it must inflate its body by drinking over 2.6 gallons of water all at once.

Name: Ledian
Description: It has a steel-hard body. It intimidates foes by upraising its eye-patterned pincers.

Name: Spinarak
Description: The BERRIES it stores in its vase-like shell decompose and become a gooey liquid.

Name: Ariados
Description: It is usually docile, but if it is disturbed while sipping honey, it chases off the intruder with its horn.

Name: Crobat
Description: Its paws conceal sharp claws. If attacked, it suddenly extends the claws and startles its enemy.

Name: Chinchou
Description: If it finds honey, its crescent mark glows. It always licks its paws because they are soaked with honey.

Name: Lanturn
Description: Although it is a good climber, it prefers to snap trees with its forelegs and eat fallen BERRIES.

Name: Pichu
Description: It never sleeps. It has to keep moving because if it stopped, its magma body would cool and harden.

Name: Cleffa
Description: The shell on its back is just skin that has cooled and hardened. It breaks easily with a slight touch.

Name: Igglybuff
Description: It rubs its snout on the ground to find and dig up food. It sometimes discovers hot springs.

Name: Togepi
Description: Because the long hair all over its body obscures its sight, it just keeps charging repeatedly.

Name: Togetic
Description: It continuously sheds and grows. The tip of its head is prized as a treasure for its beauty.

Name: Natu
Description: It has superb accuracy. The water it shoots out can strike even moving prey from more than 300 feet.

Name: Xatu
Description: It traps enemies with its suction- cupped tentacles then smashes them with its rock-hard head.

Name: Mareep
Description: It carries food all day long. There are tales about lost people who were saved by the food it had.

Name: Flaaffy
Description: As it majestically swims, it doesn't care if REMORAID attach to it for scavenging its leftovers.

Name: Ampharos
Description: Its sturdy wings look heavy, but they are actually hollow and light, allowing it to fly freely in the sky.

Name: Mega Ampharos
Description: It uses different kinds of cries for communicating with others of its kind and for pursuing its prey.

Name: Bellossom
Description: If you are burned by the flames it shoots from its mouth, the pain will never go away.

Name: Marill
Description: It is said that it usually hides in underwater caves. It can create whirlpools by yawning.

Name: Azumarill
Description: It swings its long snout around playfully, but because it is so strong, that can be dangerous.

Name: Sudowoodo
Description: It has sharp, hard tusks and a rugged hide. Its TACKLE is strong enough to knock down a house.

Name: Politoed
Description: This upgraded version of PORYGON is designed for space exploration. It can't fly, though.

Name: Hoppip
Description: The curved antlers subtly change the flow of air to create a strange space where reality is distorted.

Name: Skiploom
Description: A special fluid oozes from the tip of its tail. It paints the fluid everywhere to mark its territory.

Name: Jumpluff
Description: It is always bursting with energy. To make itself stronger, it keeps on fighting even if it loses.

Name: Aipom
Description: If you become enchanted by its smooth, elegant, dance-like kicks, you may get drilled hard.

Name: Sunkern
Description: Its lips are the most sensitive parts on its body. It always uses its lips first to examine things.

Name: Sunflora
Description: It rotates its arms to generate electricity, but it tires easily, so it charges up only a little bit.

Name: Yanma
Description: Each and every time it inhales and exhales, hot embers dribble out of its mouth and nostrils.

Name: Wooper
Description: Its milk is packed with nutrition, making it the ultimate beverage for the sick or weary.

Name: Quagsire
Description: Anyone who takes even one bite of BLISSEY's egg becomes unfailingly caring and pleasant to everyone.

Name: Espeon
Description: The rain clouds it carries let it fire thunderbolts at will. They say that it descended with lightning.

Name: Umbreon
Description: Volcanoes erupt when it barks. Unable to restrain its extreme power, it races headlong around the land.

Name: Murkrow
Description: It races around the world to purify fouled water. It dashes away with the north wind.

Name: Slowking
Description: It feeds on soil. After it has eaten a large mountain, it will fall asleep so it can grow.

Name: Mega Slowking
Description: Its shell is as hard as sheet rock, and it is also very strong. Its THRASHING can topple a mountain.

Name: Misdreavus
Description: Its body can't be harmed by any sort of attack, so it is very eager to make challenges against enemies.

Name: Unown
Description: It is said that it quietly spends its time deep at the bottom of the sea because its powers are too strong.

Name: Wobbuffet
Description: Legends claim this Pokemon flies the world's skies continuously on its magnificent seven- colored wings.

Name: Girafarig
Description: This Pokemon wanders across time. Grass and trees flourish in the forests in which it has appeared.

Name: Pineco
Description: TREECKO has small hooks on the bottom of its feet that enable it to scale vertical walls. This Pokemon attacks by slamming foes with its thick tail.

Name: Forretress
Description: The leaves growing out of GROVYLE's body are convenient for camouflaging it from enemies in the forest. This Pokemon is a master at climbing trees in jungles.

Name: Dunsparce
Description: The leaves growing on SCEPTILE's body are very sharp edged. This Pokemon is very agile - it leaps all over the branches of trees and jumps on its foe from above or behind.

Name: Gligar
Description: TORCHIC sticks with its TRAINER, following behind with unsteady steps. This Pokemon breathes fire of over 1,800 degrees F, including fireballs that leave the foe scorched black.

Name: Steelix
Description: COMBUSKEN toughens up its legs and thighs by running through fields and mountains. This Pokemon's legs possess both speed and power, enabling it to dole out ten kicks in one second.

Name: Mega Steelix
Description: In battle, BLAZIKEN blows out intense flames from its wrists and attacks foes courageously. The stronger the foe, the more intensely this Pokemon's wrists burn.

Name: Snubbull
Description: The fin on MUDKIP's head acts as highly sensitive radar. Using this fin to sense movements of water and air, this Pokemon can determine what is taking place around it without using its eyes.

Name: Granbull
Description: The surface of MARSHTOMP's body is enveloped by a thin, sticky film that enables it to live on land. This Pokemon plays in mud on beaches when the ocean tide is low.

Name: Qwilfish
Description: SWAMPERT is very strong. It has enough power to easily drag a boulder weighing more than a ton. This Pokemon also has powerful vision that lets it see even in murky water.

Name: Scizor
Description: At first sight, POOCHYENA takes a bite at anything that moves. This Pokemon chases after prey until the victim becomes exhausted. However, it may turn tail if the prey strikes back.

Name: Mega Scizor
Description: MIGHTYENA gives obvious signals when it is preparing to attack. It starts to growl deeply and then flattens its body. This Pokemon will bite savagely with its sharply pointed fangs.

Name: Shuckle
Description: ZIGZAGOON restlessly wanders everywhere at all times. This Pokemon does so because it is very curious. It becomes interested in anything that it happens to see.

Name: Heracross
Description: LINOONE always runs full speed and only in straight lines. If facing an obstacle, it makes a right-angle turn to evade it. This Pokemon is very challenged by gently curving roads.

Name: Mega Heracross
Description: Using the spikes on its rear end,   WURMPLE peels the bark off trees and feeds on the sap that oozes out. This Pokemon's feet are tipped with suction pads that allow it to cling to glass without slipping.

Name: Sneasel
Description: SILCOON tethers itself to a tree branch using silk to keep from falling. There,  this Pokemon hangs quietly while it awaits evolution. It peers out of the silk cocoon through a small hole.

Name: Teddiursa
Description: BEAUTIFLY's favorite food is the sweet pollen of flowers. If you want to see this Pokemon, just leave a potted flower by an open window. BEAUTIFLY is sure to come looking for pollen.

Name: Ursaring
Description: CASCOON makes its protective cocoon by wrapping its body entirely with a fine silk from its mouth. Once the silk goes around its body, it hardens. This Pokemon prepares for its evolution inside the cocoon.

Name: Slugma
Description: DUSTOX is instinctively drawn to light. Swarms of this Pokemon are attracted by the bright lights of cities, where they wreak havoc by stripping the leaves off roadside trees for food.

Name: Magcargo
Description: It searches about for clean water. If it does not drink water for too long, the leaf on its head wilts.

Name: Swinub
Description: It lives at the water's edge where it is sunny. It sleeps on a bed of water grass by day and becomes active at night.

Name: Piloswine
Description: LUDICOLO begins dancing as soon as it hears cheerful, festive music. This Pokemon is said to appear when it hears the singing of children on hiking outings.

Name: Corsola
Description: SEEDOT attaches itself to a tree branch using the top of its head. It sucks moisture from the tree while hanging off the branch. The more water it drinks, the glossier this Pokemon's body becomes.

Name: Mega Corsola
Description: NUZLEAF live in densely overgrown forests. They occasionally venture out of the forest to startle people. This Pokemon dislikes having its long nose pinched.

Name: Remoraid
Description: It lives quietly in the deep forest. It is said to create chilly winter winds with the fans it holds.

Name: Octillery
Description: TAILLOW courageously stands its ground against foes, however strong they may be. This gutsy Pokemon will remain defiant even after a loss. On the other hand, it cries loudly if it becomes hungry.

Name: Delibird
Description: SWELLOW flies high above our heads, making graceful arcs in the sky. This Pokemon dives at a steep angle as soon as it spots its prey. The hapless prey is tightly grasped by SWELLOW's clawed feet, preventing escape.

Name: Mantine
Description: WINGULL has the habit of carrying prey and valuables in its beak and hiding them in all sorts of locations. This Pokemon rides the winds and flies as if it were skating across the sky.

Name: Skarmory
Description: It is a messenger of the skies, carrying small Pokemon and eggs to safety in its bill.

Name: Houndour
Description: RALTS senses the emotions of people using the horns on its head. This Pokemon rarely appears before people. But when it does, it draws closer if it senses that the person has a positive disposition.

Name: Houndoom
Description: It is said that a KIRLIA that is exposed to the positive emotions of its TRAINER grows beautiful. This Pokemon controls psychokinetic powers with its highly developed brain.

Name: Mega Houndoom
Description: GARDEVOIR has the ability to read the future. If it senses impending danger to its TRAINER, this Pokemon is said to unleash its psychokinetic energy at full power.

Name: Kingdra
Description: From the tips of its feet, SURSKIT secretes an oil that enables it to walk on water as if it were skating. This Pokemon feeds on microscopic organisms in ponds and lakes.

Name: Phanpy
Description: MASQUERAIN intimidates enemies with the eyelike patterns on its antennas. This Pokemon flaps its four wings to freely fly in any direction - even sideways and backwards - as if it were a helicopter.

Name: Donphan
Description: SHROOMISH live in damp soil in the dark depths of forests. They are often found keeping still under fallen leaves. This Pokemon feeds on compost that is made up of fallen, rotted leaves.

Name: Porygon2
Description: BRELOOM closes in on its foe with light and sprightly footwork, then throws punches with its stretchy arms. This Pokemon's fighting technique puts boxers to shame.

Name: Stantler
Description: SLAKOTH lolls around for over twenty hours every day. Because it moves so little, it does not need much food. This Pokemon's sole daily meal consists of just three leaves.

Name: Smeargle
Description: VIGOROTH is always itching and agitated to go on a wild rampage. It simply can't tolerate sitting still for even a minute. This Pokemon's stress level rises if it can't be moving constantly.

Name: Tyrogue
Description: SLAKING spends all day lying down and lolling about. It eats grass growing within its reach. If it eats all the grass it can reach, this Pokemon reluctantly moves to another spot.

Name: Hitmontop
Description: NINCADA lives underground for many years in complete darkness. This Pokemon absorbs nutrients from the roots of trees. It stays motionless as it waits for evolution.

Name: Smoochum
Description: NINJASK moves around at such a high speed that it cannot be seen, even while its crying can be clearly heard. For that reason, this Pokemon was long believed to be invisible.

Name: Elekid
Description: SHEDINJA's hard body doesn't move - not even a twitch. In fact, its body appears to be merely a hollow shell. It is believed that this Pokemon will steal the spirit of anyone peering into its hollow body from its back.

Name: Magby
Description: Normally, WHISMUR's voice is very quiet - it is barely audible even if one is paying close attention. However, if this Pokemon senses danger, it starts crying at an earsplitting volume.

Name: Miltank
Description: LOUDRED's bellowing can completely decimate a wood-frame house. It uses its voice to punish its foes. This Pokemon's round ears serve as loudspeakers.

Name: Blissey
Description: EXPLOUD triggers earthquakes with the tremors it creates by bellowing. If this Pokemon violently inhales from the ports on its body, it's a sign that it is preparing to let loose a huge bellow.

Name: Raikou
Description: MAKUHITA is tenacious - it will keep getting up and attacking its foe however many times it is knocked down. Every time it gets back up, this Pokemon stores more energy in its body for evolving.

Name: Entei
Description: It has the habit of challenging others without hesitation to tests of strength. It's been known to stand on train tracks and stop trains using forearm thrusts.

Name: Suicune
Description: A Pokemon that lives by water. It moves quickly on land by bouncing on its big tail.

Name: Larvitar
Description: NOSEPASS's magnetic nose is always pointed to the north. If two of these Pokemon meet, they cannot turn their faces to each other when they are close because their magnetic noses repel one another.

Name: Pupitar
Description: SKITTY has the habit of becoming fascinated by moving objects and chasing them around. This Pokemon is known to chase after its own tail and become dizzy.

Name: Tyranitar
Description: DELCATTY prefers to live an unfettered existence in which it can do as it pleases at its own pace. Because this Pokemon eats and sleeps whenever it decides, its daily routines are completely random.

Name: Mega Tyranitar
Description: SABLEYE lead quiet lives deep inside caverns. They are feared, however, because these Pokemon are thought to steal the spirits of people when their eyes burn with a sinister glow in the darkness.

Name: Lugia
Description: MAWHILE's huge jaws are actually steel horns that have been transformed. Its docile-looking face serves to lull its foe into letting down its guard. When the foe least expects it, MAWHILE chomps it with its gaping jaws.

Name: Ho-oh
Description: This Pokemon has a body of steel. To make its body, ARON feeds on iron ore that it digs from mountains. Occasionally, it causes major trouble by eating bridges and rails.

Name: Celebi
Description: LAIRON tempers its steel body by drinking highly nutritious mineral springwater until it is bloated. This Pokemon makes its nest close to springs of delicious water.

Name: Treecko
Description: AGGRON claims an entire mountain as its own territory. It mercilessly beats up anything that violates its environment. This Pokemon vigilantly patrols its territory at all times.

Name: Grovyle
Description: MEDITITE undertakes rigorous mental training deep in the mountains. However, whenever it meditates, this Pokemon always loses its concentration and focus. As a result, its training never ends.

Name: Sceptile
Description: It is said that through meditation, MEDICHAM heightens energy inside its body and sharpens its sixth sense. This Pokemon hides its presence by merging itself with fields and mountains.

Name: Mega Sceptile
Description: ELECTRIKE stores electricity in its long body hair. This Pokemon stimulates its leg muscles with electric charges. These jolts of power give its legs explosive acceleration performance.

Name: Torchic
Description: MANECTRIC is constantly discharging electricity from its mane. The sparks sometimes ignite forest fires. When it enters a battle, this Pokemon creates thunderclouds.

Name: Combusken
Description: PLUSLE always acts as a cheerleader for its partners. Whenever a teammate puts out a good effort in battle, this Pokemon shorts out its body to create the crackling noises of sparks to show its joy.

Name: Blaziken
Description: MINUN is more concerned about cheering on its partners than its own safety. It shorts out the electricity in its body to create brilliant showers of sparks to cheer on its teammates.

Name: Mega Blaziken
Description: With the arrival of night, VOLBEAT emits light from its tail. It communicates with others by adjusting the intensity and flashing of its light. This Pokemon is attracted by the sweet aroma of ILLUMISE.

Name: Mudkip
Description: With its sweet aroma, it guides Volbeat to draw signs with light in the night sky.

Name: Marshtomp
Description: ROSELIA shoots sharp thorns as projectiles at any opponent that tries to steal the flowers on its arms. The aroma of this Pokemon brings serenity to living things.

Name: Swampert
Description: Virtually all of GULPIN's body is its stomach. As a result, it can swallow something its own size. This Pokemon's stomach contains a special fluid that digests anything.

Name: Mega Swampert
Description: When SWALOT spots prey, it spurts out a hideously toxic fluid from its pores and sprays the target. Once the prey has weakened, this Pokemon gulps it down whole with its cavernous mouth.

Name: Poochyena
Description: CARVANHA's strongly developed jaws and its sharply pointed fangs pack the destructive power to rip out boat hulls. Many boats have been attacked and sunk by this Pokemon.

Name: Mightyena
Description: Nicknamed “the bully of the sea,” SHARPEDO is widely feared. Its cruel fangs grow back immediately if they snap off. Just one of these Pokemon can thoroughly tear apart a supertanker.

Name: Zigzagoon
Description: WAILMER's nostrils are located above its eyes. This playful Pokemon loves to startle people by forcefully snorting out seawater it stores inside its body out of its nostrils.

Name: Mega Zigzagoon
Description: WAILORD is the largest of all identified Pokemon up to now. This giant Pokemon swims languorously in the vast open sea, eating massive amounts of food at once with its enormous mouth.

Name: Linoone
Description: NUMEL is extremely dull witted - it doesn't notice being hit. However, it can't stand hunger for even a second. This Pokemon's body is a seething cauldron of boiling magma.

Name: Mega Linoone
Description: CAMERUPT has a volcano inside its body. Magma of 18,000 degrees F courses through its body. Occasionally, the humps on this Pokemon's back erupt, spewing the superheated magma.

Name: Wurmple
Description: You can tell how it's feeling by the smoke spouting from its shell. Tremendous velocity is a sign of good health.

Name: Silcoon
Description: SPOINK bounces around on its tail. The shock of its bouncing makes its heart pump. As a result, this Pokemon cannot afford to stop bouncing - if it stops, its heart will stop.

Name: Beautifly
Description: GRUMPIG uses the black pearls on its body to amplify its psychic power waves for gaining total control over its foe. When this Pokemon uses its special power, its snorting breath grows labored.

Name: Cascoon
Description: No two Spinda have the same pattern of spots. Its tottering step fouls the aim of foes.

Name: Dustox
Description: TRAPINCH's nest is a sloped, bowl-like pit dug in sand. This Pokemon patiently waits for prey to tumble down the pit. Its giant jaws have enough strength to crush even boulders.

Name: Lotad
Description: To make prey faint, VIBRAVA generates ultrasonic waves by vigorously making its two wings vibrate. This Pokemon's ultrasonic waves are so powerful, they can bring on headaches in people.

Name: Lombre
Description: FLYGON is nicknamed “the elemental  spirit of the desert.” Because its flapping wings whip up a cloud of sand, this Pokemon is always enveloped in a sandstorm while flying.

Name: Ludicolo
Description: CACNEA lives in arid locations such as deserts. It releases a strong aroma from its flower to attract prey. When prey comes near, this Pokemon shoots sharp thorns from its body to bring the victim down.

Name: Seedot
Description: During the daytime, CACTURNE remains unmoving so that it does not lose any moisture to the harsh desert sun. This Pokemon becomes active at night when the temperature drops.

Name: Nuzleaf
Description: SWABLU has light and fluffy wings that are like cottony clouds. This Pokemon is not frightened of people. It lands on the heads of people and sits there like a cotton-fluff hat.

Name: Shiftry
Description: ALTARIA dances and wheels through the sky among billowing, cotton-like clouds. By singing melodies in its crystal-clear voice, this Pokemon makes its listeners experience dreamy wonderment.

Name: Taillow
Description: Memories of battling its arch-rival SEVIPER are etched into every cell of ZANGOOSE's body. This Pokemon adroitly dodges attacks with incredible agility.

Name: Swellow
Description: SEVIPER shares a generations-long feud with ZANGOOSE. The scars on its body are evidence of vicious battles. This Pokemon attacks using its sword- edged tail.

Name: Wingull
Description: LUNATONE was discovered at a location where a meteorite fell. As a result, some people theorize that this Pokemon came from space. However, no one has been able to prove this theory so far.

Name: Pelipper
Description: Solar energy is the source of its power, so it is strong during the daytime. When it spins, its body shines.

Name: Ralts
Description: BARBOACH's sensitive whiskers serve as a superb radar system. This Pokemon hides in mud, leaving only its two whiskers exposed while it waits for prey to come along.

Name: Kirlia
Description: WHISCASH is extremely territorial. Just one of these Pokemon will claim a large pond as its exclusive territory. If a foe approaches it, it thrashes about and triggers a massive earthquake.

Name: Gardevoir
Description: Its hardy vitality enables it to adapt to any environment. Its pincers will never release prey.

Name: Mega Gardevoir
Description: CRAWDAUNT has an extremely violent nature that compels it to challenge other living things to battle. Other life-forms refuse to live in ponds inhabited by this Pokemon, making them desolate places.

Name: Surskit
Description: BALTOY moves while spinning around on its one foot. Primitive wall paintings depicting this Pokemon living among people were discovered in some ancient ruins.

Name: Masquerain
Description: CLAYDOL are said to be dolls of mud made by primitive humans and brought to life by exposure to a mysterious ray. This Pokemon moves about while levitating.

Name: Shroomish
Description: LILEEP became extinct approximately a hundred million years ago. This ancient Pokemon attaches itself to a rock on the seafloor and catches approaching prey using tentacles  shaped like flower petals.

Name: Breloom
Description: CRADILY roams around the ocean floor in search of food. This Pokemon freely extends its tree trunk-like neck and captures unwary prey using its eight tentacles.

Name: Slakoth
Description: ANORITH was regenerated from a prehistoric fossil. This primitive Pokemon once lived in warm seas. It grips its prey firmly between its two large claws.

Name: Vigoroth
Description: ARMALDO's tough armor makes all attacks bounce off. This Pokemon's two enormous claws can be freely extended or contracted. They have the power to punch right through a steel slab.

Name: Slaking
Description: FEEBAS's fins are ragged and tattered from the start of its life. Because of its shoddy appearance, this Pokemon is largely ignored. It is capable of living in both the sea and in rivers.

Name: Nincada
Description: Its lovely scales are described as rainbow colored. They change color depending on the viewing angle.

Name: Ninjask
Description: CASTFORM's appearance changes with the weather. This Pokemon gained the ability to use the vast power of nature to protect its tiny body.

Name: Shedinja
Description: It changes body color to blend in with its surroundings. It also changes color if it is happy or sad.

Name: Whismur
Description: SHUPPET is attracted by feelings of jealousy and vindictiveness. If someone develops strong feelings of vengeance, this Pokemon will appear in a swarm and line up beneath the eaves of that person's home.

Name: Loudred
Description: BANETTE generates energy for laying strong curses by sticking pins into its own body. This Pokemon was originally a pitiful plush doll that was thrown away.

Name: Exploud
Description: DUSKULL can pass through any wall no matter how thick it may be. Once this Pokemon chooses a target, it will doggedly pursue the intended victim until the break of dawn.

Name: Makuhita
Description: DUSCLOPS's body is completely hollow - there is nothing at all inside. It is said that its body is like a black hole. This Pokemon will absorb anything into its body, but nothing will ever come back out.

Name: Hariyama
Description: The bunches of fruit around TROPIUS's neck are very popular with children. This Pokemon loves fruit, and eats it continuously. Apparently, its love for fruit resulted in its own outgrowth of fruit.

Name: Azurill
Description: CHIMECHO makes its cries echo inside its hollow body. When this Pokemon becomes enraged, its cries result in ultrasonic waves that have the power to knock foes flying.

Name: Nosepass
Description: Every time ABSOL appears before people, it is followed by a disaster such as an earthquake or a tidal wave. As a result, it came to be known as the disaster Pokemon.

Name: Skitty
Description: WYNAUT can always be seen with a big, happy smile on its face. Look at its tail to determine if it is angry. When angered, this Pokemon will be slapping the ground with its tail.

Name: Delcatty
Description: SNORUNT live in regions with heavy snowfall. In seasons without snow, such as spring and summer, this Pokemon steals away to live quietly among stalactites and stalagmites deep in caverns.

Name: Sableye
Description: GLALIE has a body made of rock, which it hardens with an armor of ice. This Pokemon has the ability to freeze moisture in the atmosphere into any shape it desires.

Name: Mega Sableye
Description: SPHEAL is much faster rolling than  walking to get around. When groups of this Pokemon eat, they all clap at once to show their pleasure. Because of this, their mealtimes are noisy.

Name: Mawile
Description: SEALEO has the habit of always juggling on the tip of its nose anything it sees for the first time. This Pokemon occasionally entertains itself by balancing and rolling a SPHEAL on its nose.

Name: Mega Mawile
Description: It swims through icy seas while shattering ice floes with its large tusks. It is protected by its thick blubber.

Name: Aron
Description: CLAMPERL's sturdy shell is not only good for protection - it is also used for clamping and catching prey. A fully grown CLAMPERL's shell will be scored with nicks and scratches all over.

Name: Lairon
Description: HUNTAIL's presence went unnoticed by people for a long time because it lives at extreme depths in the sea. This Pokemon's eyes can see clearly even in the murky dark depths of the ocean.

Name: Aggron
Description: GOREBYSS lives in the southern seas at extreme depths. Its body is built to withstand the enormous pressure of water at incredible depths. Because of this, this Pokemon's body is unharmed by ordinary attacks.

Name: Mega Aggron
Description: RELICANTH is a Pokemon species that existed for a hundred million years without ever changing its form. This ancient Pokemon feeds on microscopic organisms with its toothless mouth.

Name: Meditite
Description: LUVDISC live in shallow seas in the tropics. This heart-shaped Pokemon earned its name by swimming after loving couples it spotted in the ocean's waves.

Name: Medicham
Description: Dreaming of one day flying, it practices by leaping off cliffs every day.

Name: Mega Medicham
Description: Inside SHELGON's armor-like shell, cells are in the midst of transformation to create an entirely new body. This Pokemon's shell is extremely heavy, making its movements sluggish.

Name: Electrike
Description: SALAMENCE came about as a result of a strong, long-held dream of growing wings. It is said that this powerful desire triggered a sudden mutation in this Pokemon's cells, causing it to sprout its magnificent wings.

Name: Manectric
Description: Instead of blood, a powerful magnetic force courses throughout BELDUM's body. This Pokemon communicates with others by sending controlled pulses of magnetism.

Name: Mega Manectric
Description: When two BELDUM fuse together, METANG is formed. The brains of the BELDUM are joined by a magnetic nervous system. By linking its brains magnetically, this Pokemon generates strong psychokinetic power.

Name: Plusle
Description: METAGROSS has four brains in total. Combined, the four brains can breeze through difficult calculations faster than a supercomputer. This Pokemon can float in the air by tucking in its four legs.

Name: Minun
Description: Its entire body is made of rock. If any part chips off in battle, it attaches rocks to repair itself.

Name: Volbeat
Description: REGICE's body was made during an ice age. The deep-frozen body can't be melted, even by fire. This Pokemon controls frigid air of minus 328 degrees F.

Name: Illumise
Description: REGISTEEL has a body that is harder than any kind of metal. Its body is apparently hollow. No one has any idea what this Pokemon eats.

Name: Roselia
Description: LATIAS is highly sensitive to the emotions of people. If it senses any hostility, this Pokemon ruffles the feathers all over its body and cries shrilly to intimidate the foe.

Name: Gulpin
Description: LATIOS has the ability to make its foe see an image of what it has seen or imagines in its head. This Pokemon is intelligent and understands human speech.

Name: Swalot
Description: KYOGRE has the power to create massive rain clouds that cover the entire sky and bring about torrential downpours. This Pokemon saved people who were suffering from droughts.

Name: Carvanha
Description: GROUDON has long been described in  mythology as the Pokemon that raised lands and expanded continents. This Pokemon took to sleep after a cataclysmic battle with KYOGRE.

Name: Sharpedo
Description: RAYQUAZA lived for hundreds of millions of years in the earth's ozone layer,  never descending to the ground. This Pokemon appears to feed on water and particles in the atmosphere.

Name: Mega Sharpedo
Description: A legend states that JIRACHI will make true any wish that is written on notes attached to its head when it awakens. If this Pokemon senses danger, it will fight without awakening.

Name: Wailmer
Description: The DNA of a space virus underwent a sudden mutation upon exposure to a laser beam and resulted in DEOXYS. The crystalline organ on this Pokemon's chest appears to be its brain.

Name: Wailord
Description: Made from soil, the shell on its back hardens when it drinks water. It lives along lakes.

Name: Numel
Description: It knows where pure water wells up. It carries fellow Pokemon there on its back.

Name: Camerupt
Description: Small Pokemon occasionally gather on its unmoving back to begin building their nests.

Name: Mega Camerupt
Description: It agilely scales sheer cliffs to live atop craggy mountains. Its fire is put out when it sleeps.

Name: Torkoal
Description: To intimidate attackers, it stretches the fire on its tail to make itself appear bigger.

Name: Spoink
Description: It uses a special kind of martial arts involving all its limbs. Its fire never goes out.

Name: Grumpig
Description: Because it is very proud, it hates accepting food from people. Its thick down guards it from cold.

Name: Spinda
Description: It lives alone, away from others. Apparently, every one of them believes it is the most important.

Name: Trapinch
Description: The three horns that extend from its beak attest to its power. The leader has the biggest horns.

Name: Vibrava
Description: They flock in great numbers. Though small, they flap their wings with great power.

Name: Flygon
Description: It flies around forests and fields in search of bug Pokemon. It stays within a huge flock.

Name: Cacnea
Description: It has a savage nature. It will courageously challenge foes that are much larger.

Name: Cacturne
Description: With nerves of steel, nothing can perturb it. It is more agile and active than it appears.

Name: Swablu
Description: It makes its nest by damming streams with bark and mud. It is known as an industrious worker.

Name: Altaria
Description: It shakes its head back to front, causing its antennae to hit each other and sound like a xylophone.

Name: Mega Altaria
Description: It crosses its knifelike arms in front of its chest when it cries. It can compose melodies ad lib.

Name: Zangoose
Description: All of its fur dazzles if danger is sensed. It flees while the foe is momentarily blinded.

Name: Seviper
Description: Its claws loose electricity with enough amperage to cause fainting. They live in small groups.

Name: Lunatone
Description: It has eyes that can see through anything. It spots and captures prey hiding behind objects.

Name: Solrock
Description: Over the winter, it closes its bud and endures the cold. In spring, the bud opens and releases pollen.

Name: Barboach
Description: It attracts prey with a sweet aroma, then downs it with thorny whips hidden in its arms.

Name: Whiscash
Description: It lived in jungles around 100 million years ago. Its skull is as hard as iron.

Name: Corphish
Description: Its powerful head butt has enough power to shatter even the most durable things upon impact.

Name: Crawdaunt
Description: A Pokemon that lived in jungles around 100 million years ago. Its facial hide is extremely hard.

Name: Baltoy
Description: Any frontal attack is repulsed. It is a docile Pokemon that feeds on grass and berries.

Name: Claydol
Description: To shelter itself from cold, wintry winds, it covers itself with a cloak made of twigs and leaves.

Name: Lileep
Description: When BURMY evolved, its cloak became a part of this Pokemon's body. The cloak is never shed.

Name: Cradily
Description: It loves the honey of flowers and steals honey collected by COMBEE.

Name: Anorith
Description: A Pokemon formed by three others. It busily carries sweet floral honey to VESPIQUEN.

Name: Armaldo
Description: Its abdomen is a honeycomb for grubs. It raises its grubs on honey collected by COMBEE.

Name: Feebas
Description: It makes fur balls that crackle with static electricity. It stores them with berries in tree holes.

Name: Milotic
Description: It has a flotation sac that is like an inflatable collar. It floats on water with its head out.

Name: Castform
Description: It floats using its well-developed flotation sac. It assists in the rescues of drowning people.

Name: Mega Castform
Description: The small ball holds the nutrients needed for evolution. Apparently, it is very sweet and tasty.

Name: Mega Castform X
Description: It blooms during times of strong sunlight. It tries to make up for everything it endured as a bud.

Name: Mega Castform X
Description: Its colors and shapes differ from region to region. In the Sinnoh region, two types are confirmed.

Name: Kecleon
Description: It has a pliable body without any bones. If any part of its body is torn off, it grows right back.

Name: Shuppet
Description: To eat, it deftly shucks nuts with its two tails. It rarely uses its arms now.

Name: Banette
Description: A Pokemon formed by the spirits of people and Pokemon. It loves damp, humid seasons.

Name: Mega Banette
Description: At dusk, swarms of them are carried aloft on winds. When noticed, they suddenly vanish.

Name: Duskull
Description: It slams foes by sharply uncoiling its rolled ears. It stings enough to make a grown-up cry in pain.

Name: Dusclops
Description: An extremely cautious Pokemon. It cloaks its body with its fluffy ear fur when it senses danger.

Name: Tropius
Description: Its cries sound like incantations. Those hearing it are tormented by headaches and hallucinations.

Name: Chimecho
Description: Becoming active at night, it is known to swarm with numerous MURKROW in tow.

Name: Absol
Description: It claws if displeased and purrs when affectionate. Its fickleness is very popular among some.

Name: Mega Absol
Description: It is a brazen brute that barges its way into another Pokemon's nest and claims it as its own.

Name: Wynaut
Description: It emits cries by agitating an orb at the back of its throat. It moves with flouncing hops.

Name: Snorunt
Description: It protects itself by spraying a noxious fluid from its rear. The stench lingers for 24 hours.

Name: Glalie
Description: It sprays a vile-smelling fluid from the tip of its tail to attack. Its range is over 160 feet.

Name: Mega Glalie
Description: Implements shaped like it were discovered in ancient tombs. It is unknown if they are related.

Name: Spheal
Description: One caused a news sensation when it was dug up at a construction site after a 2,000-year sleep.

Name: Sealeo
Description: It looks as if it is always crying. It is actually adjusting its body's fluid levels by eliminating excess.

Name: Walrein
Description: It habitually mimics foes. Once mimicked, the foe cannot take its eyes off this Pokemon.

Name: Clamperl
Description: It loves round white things. It carries an egg-shaped rock in imitation of CHANSEY.

Name: Huntail
Description: It can learn and speak human words. If they gather, they all learn the same saying.

Name: Gorebyss
Description: A Pokemon that was formed by 108 spirits. It is bound to a fissure in an odd keystone.

Name: Relicanth
Description: It nests in small, horizontal holes in cave walls. It pounces to catch prey that stray too close.

Name: Luvdisc
Description: There is a long-held belief that medicine made from its scales will heal even incurable illnesses.

Name: Bagon
Description: When it folds up its body and extends its wings, it looks like a jet plane. It flies at sonic speed.

Name: Shelgon
Description: It wolfs down its weight in food once a day, swallowing food whole with almost no chewing.

Name: Salamence
Description: The aura that emanates from its body intensifies to alert others if it is afraid or sad.

Name: Mega Salamence
Description: It has the ability to sense the auras of all things. It understands human speech.

Name: Beldum
Description: It lives in arid places. Instead of perspiration, it expels grainy sand from its body.

Name: Metang
Description: It blasts internally stored sand from ports on its body to create a towering twister for attack.

Name: Metagross
Description: It grips prey with its tail claws and injects poison. It tenaciously hangs on until the poison takes.

Name: Mega Metagross
Description: It has the power in its clawed arms to make scrap of a car. The tips of its claws release poison.

Name: Regirock
Description: Its cheeks hold poison sacs. It tries to catch foes off guard to jab them with toxic fingers.

Name: Regice
Description: Its knuckle claws secrete a toxin so vile that even a scratch could prove fatal.

Name: Registeel
Description: It attracts prey with its sweet- smelling saliva, then chomps down. It takes a whole day to eat prey.

Name: Latias
Description: After long exposure to sunlight, the patterns on its tail fins shine vividly when darkness arrives.

Name: Mega Latias
Description: It lives on the deep-sea floor. It attracts prey by flashing the patterns on its four tail fins.

Name: Latios
Description: A friendly Pokemon that captures the subtle flows of seawater using its two antennae.

Name: Mega Latios
Description: It lives on snowy mountains. Having had little contact with humans, it is boldly inquisitive.

Name: Kyogre
Description: It whips up blizzards in mountains that are always buried in snow. It is the abominable snowman.

Name: Mega Kyogre
Description: They live in cold regions, forming groups of four or five that hunt prey with impressive coordination.

Name: Groudon
Description: It evolved from exposure to a special magnetic field. Three units generate magnetism.

Name: Mega Groudon
Description: It wraps things with its extensible tongue. Getting too close to it will leave you soaked with drool.

Name: Rayquaza
Description: It puts rocks in holes in its palms and uses its muscles to shoot them. GEODUDE are shot at rare times.

Name: Mega Rayquaza
Description: It ensnares prey by extending arms made of vines. Losing arms to predators does not trouble it.

Name: Jirachi
Description: As its electric charge amplifies, blue sparks begin to crackle between its horns.

Name: Deoxys
Description: It blasts fireballs of over 3,600 degrees F from the ends of its arms. It lives in volcanic craters.

Name: Mega Deoxys
Description: It will never appear where there is strife. Its sightings have become rare recently.

Name: Mega Deoxys X
Description: By churning its wings, it creates shock waves that inflict critical internal injuries to foes.

Name: Mega Deoxys X
Description: Just like a plant, it uses photosynthesis. As a result, it is always enveloped in clear air.

Name: Turtwig
Description: As a protective technique, it can completely freeze its fur to make its hairs stand like needles.

Name: Grotle
Description: It observes prey while hanging inverted from branches. When the chance presents itself, it swoops!

Name: Torterra
Description: Its impressive tusks are made of ice. The population thinned when it turned warm after the ice age.

Name: Chimchar
Description: Additional software was installed to make it a better Pokemon. It began acting oddly, however.

Name: Monferno
Description: A master of courtesy and swordsmanship, it fights using extending swords on its elbows.

Name: Infernape
Description: It freely controls three small units called Mini-Noses using magnetic force.

Name: Piplup
Description: The antenna on its head captures radio waves from the world of spirits that command it to take people there.

Name: Prinplup
Description: It freezes foes with an icy breath nearly -60 degrees F. What seems to be its body is actually hollow.

Name: Empoleon
Description: Its body is composed of plasma. It is known to infiltrate electronic devices and wreak havoc.

Name: Starly
Description: Known as “The Being of Knowledge.” It is said that it can wipe out the memory of those who see its eyes.

Name: Staravia
Description: Known as “The Being of Emotion.” It taught humans the nobility of sorrow, pain, and joy.

Name: Staraptor
Description: Known as “The Being of Willpower.” It sleeps at the bottom of a lake to keep the world in balance.

Name: Bidoof
Description: It has the power to control time. It appears in Sinnoh-region myths as an ancient deity.

Name: Bibarel
Description: It has the ability to distort space. It is described as a deity in Sinnoh-region mythology.

Name: Kricketot
Description: It dwells in volcanic caves. It digs in with its cross-shaped feet to crawl on ceilings and walls.

Name: Kricketune
Description: There is an enduring legend that states this Pokemon towed continents with ropes.

Name: Shinx
Description: A Pokemon that is said to live in a world on the reverse side of ours. It appears in an ancient cemetery.

Name: Luxio
Description: Shiny particles are released from its wings like a veil. It is said to represent the crescent moon.

Name: Luxray
Description: It drifts in warm seas. It always returns to where it was born, no matter how far it may have drifted.

Name: Budew
Description: Born on a cold seafloor, it will swim great distances to return to its birthplace.

Name: Roserade
Description: It can lull people to sleep and make them dream. It is active during nights of the new moon.

Name: Cranidos
Description: It lives in flower patches and avoids detection by curling up to look like a flowering plant.

Name: Rampardos
Description: It is described in mythology as the Pokemon that shaped the universe with its 1,000 arms.

Name: Shieldon
Description: This Pokemon brings victory. It is said that Trainers with Victini always win, regardless of the type of encounter.

Name: Bastiodon
Description: It is very intelligent and calm. Being exposed to lots of sunlight makes its movements swifter.

Name: Burmy
Description: It moves along the ground as if sliding. Its swift movements befuddle its foes, and it then attacks with a vine whip.

Name: Wormadam
Description: It can stop its opponents' movements with just a glare. It takes in solar energy and boosts it internally.

Name: Mega Wormadam
Description: It can deftly dodge its foe's attacks while shooting fireballs from its nose. It roasts berries before it eats them.

Name: Mega Wormadam X
Description: When its internal fire flares up, its movements grow sharper and faster. When in trouble, it emits smoke.

Name: Mothim
Description: It can throw a fire punch by setting its fists on fire with its fiery chin. It cares deeply about its friends.

Name: Combee
Description: It fights using the scalchop on its stomach. In response to an attack, it retaliates immediately by slashing.

Name: Vespiquen
Description: Strict training is how it learns its flowing double-scalchop technique.

Name: Pachirisu
Description: One swing of the sword incorporated in its armor can fell an opponent. A simple glare from one of them quiets everybody.

Name: Buizel
Description: Using food stored in cheek pouches, they can keep watch for days. They use their tails to communicate with others.

Name: Floatzel
Description: When they see an enemy, their tails stand high, and they spit the seeds of berries stored in their cheek pouches.

Name: Cherubi
Description: It faces strong opponents with great courage. But, when at a disadvantage in a fight, this intelligent Pokemon flees.

Name: Cherrim
Description: It has black, cape-like fur that is very hard and decreases the amount of damage it receives.

Name: Shellos
Description: It rescues people stranded by blizzards in the mountains. Its shaggy fur shields it from the cold.

Name: Gastrodon
Description: They steal from people for fun, but their victims can't help but forgive them. Their deceptively cute act is perfect.

Name: Ambipom
Description: These Pokemon vanish and appear unexpectedly. Many Trainers are drawn to their beautiful form and fur.

Name: Drifloon
Description: This Pokemon dwells deep in the forest. Eating a leaf from its head whisks weariness away as if by magic.

Name: Drifblim
Description: Ill tempered, it fights by swinging its barbed tail around wildly. The leaf growing on its head is very bitter.

Name: Buneary
Description: When it is angered, the temperature of its head tuft reaches 600° F. It uses its tuft to roast berries.

Name: Lopunny
Description: It loves sweets because they become energy for the fire burning inside its body.

Name: Mega Lopunny
Description: The water stored inside the tuft on its head is full of nutrients. Plants that receive its water grow large.

Name: Mismagius
Description: The tuft on its head holds water. When the level runs low, it replenishes the tuft by siphoning up water with its tail.

Name: Honchkrow
Description: Munna always float in the air. People whose dreams are eaten by them forget what the dreams had been about.

Name: Glameow
Description: The mist emanating from their foreheads is packed with the dreams of people and Pokemon.

Name: Purugly
Description: Each follows its Trainer's orders as best it can, but they sometimes fail to understand complicated commands.

Name: Chingling
Description: It can return to its Trainer's location regardless of the distance separating them.

Name: Stunky
Description: Males swing their head plumage to threaten opponents. The females' flying abilities surpass those of the males.

Name: Skuntank
Description: When thunderclouds cover the sky, it will appear. It can catch lightning with its mane and store the electricity.

Name: Bronzor
Description: They have lightning-like movements. When Zebstrika run at full speed, the sound of thunder reverberates.

Name: Bronzong
Description: Its ear is hexagonal in shape. Compressed underground, its body is as hard as steel.

Name: Bonsly
Description: When it overflows with power, the orange crystal on its body glows. It looks for underground water in caves.

Name: Mime Jr.
Description: Compressing the energy from its internal core lets it fire off an attack capable of blowing away a mountain.

Name: Happiny
Description: Its habitat is dark forests and caves. It emits ultrasonic waves from its nose to learn about its surroundings.

Name: Chatot
Description: It emits sound waves of various frequencies from its nose, including some powerful enough to destroy rocks.

Name: Spiritomb
Description: It can dig through the ground at a speed of 30 mph. It could give a car running aboveground a good race.

Name: Gible
Description: It can help in tunnel construction. Its drill has evolved into steel strong enough to bore through iron plates.

Name: Gabite
Description: It touches others with the feelers on its ears, using the sound of their heartbeats to tell how they are feeling.

Name: Garchomp
Description: It fights by swinging a piece of lumber around. It is close to evolving when it can handle the lumber without difficulty.

Name: Mega Garchomp
Description: This Pokemon is so muscular and strongly built that even a group of wrestlers could not make it budge an inch.

Name: Munchlax
Description: It is thought that Conkeldurr taught humans how to make concrete more than 2,000 years ago.

Name: Riolu
Description: They warn others of danger by vibrating their cheeks to create a high-pitched sound.

Name: Lucario
Description: When they vibrate the bumps on their heads, they can make waves in water or earthquake-like vibrations on land.

Name: Mega Lucario
Description: They shoot paralyzing liquid from their head bumps. They use vibration to hurt their opponents.

Name: Hippopotas
Description: When it tightens its belt, it becomes stronger. Wild Throh use vines to weave their own belts.

Name: Hippowdon
Description: The sound of Sawk punching boulders and trees can be heard all the way from the mountains where they train.

Name: Skorupi
Description: Leavanny dress it in clothes they made for it when it hatched. It hides its head in its hood while it is sleeping.

Name: Drapion
Description: Forests where Swadloon live have superb foliage because the nutrients they make from fallen leaves nourish the plant life.

Name: Croagunk
Description: Upon finding a small Pokemon, it weaves clothing for it from leaves, using the cutters on its arms and sticky silk.

Name: Toxicroak
Description: Its bite injects a potent poison, enough to paralyze large bird Pokemon that try to prey on it.

Name: Carnivine
Description: Protected by a hard shell, it spins its body like a wheel and crashes furiously into its enemies.

Name: Finneon
Description: With quick movements, it chases down its foes, attacking relentlessly with its horns until it prevails.

Name: Lumineon
Description: When attacked, it escapes by shooting cotton from its body. The cotton serves as a decoy to distract the attacker.

Name: Mantyke
Description: Like the wind, it can slip through any gap, no matter how small. It leaves balls of white fluff behind.

Name: Snover
Description: The leaves on its head are very bitter. Eating one of these leaves is known to refresh a tired body.

Name: Abomasnow
Description: Even veteran Trainers face a challenge in getting its beautiful flower to bloom. This Pokemon is popular with celebrities.

Name: Mega Abomasnow
Description: Red and blue Basculin get along so poorly, they'll start fighting instantly. These Pokemon are very hostile.

Name: Weavile
Description: They live buried in the sands of the desert. The sun-warmed sands prevent their body temperature from dropping.

Name: Magnezone
Description: They live in groups of a few individuals. Protective membranes shield their eyes from sandstorms.

Name: Lickilicky
Description: They never allow prey to escape. Their jaws are so powerful, they can crush the body of an automobile.

Name: Rhyperior
Description: When its internal fire is burning, it cannot calm down and it runs around. When the fire diminishes, it falls asleep.

Name: Tangrowth
Description: Its internal fire burns at 2,500° F, making enough power that it can destroy a dump truck with one punch.

Name: Electivire
